title: Message/get ids=null behavior documented as intentional deviation but KITH-hqrw.5 is open
description: Message/get (message.rs:724-742) rejects ids=null with invalidArguments. KITH-hqrw.5 is already filed for this RFC 8620 §5.1 deviation. The code has a comment (line 724: 'ids is required in v1; null or absent → invalidArguments') and a test (test_message_get_ids_none) that verifies this non-RFC behavior. This means fixing KITH-hqrw.5 will require changing both the implementation AND the test. The test is currently asserting wrong behavior as correct. When KITH-hqrw.5 is fixed, the test must be updated from expect_err to expect_ok; if the fixer only fixes the implementation but not the test, the test will start failing and the CI will reject the fix. Adding a comment to the test cross-referencing KITH-hqrw.5 would prevent this confusion.
